raw: * Extract the knxd availability report from a backend response.
* While the connection of the backend to the KNX bus (knxd) is lost, the
* backend (cometvisu-knx-fcgi with KNX_TRANSPORT=knxd) adds a "knxd"
* field to its /r and /w responses:
*   "knxd": {"ok": false, "since": <unix time of the outage start>,
*            "lastOk": <unix time of the last successful connection>}
* The field is absent as long as knxd is reachable. The backend answers
* read requests with HTTP 503 in that state, but the body still contains
* the last values it has received.
* @param response {Object|String|null} parsed or raw response body
* @return {Object|null} the knxd status or `null` if no outage is reported

@description.name: @description
@description.body: Extract the knxd availability report from a backend response. While the connection of the backend to the KNX bus (knxd) is lost, the backend (cometvisu-knx-fcgi with KNX_TRANSPORT=knxd) adds a "knxd" field to its /r and /w responses: "knxd": {"ok": false, "since": , "lastOk": } The field is absent as long as knxd is reachable. The backend answers read requests with HTTP 503 in that state, but the body still contains the last values it has received.

@param.name: @param
@param.body: response {Object|String|null} parsed or raw response body

@return.name: @return
@return.body: {Object|null} the knxd status or null if no outage is reported
@return.description: the knxd status or null if no outage is reported
